marketLayer.title: HK Tech Giants & AI Cloud Monetization
marketLayer.fact: Major HK-listed tech conglomerates reported a 35% YoY increase in cloud AI infrastructure revenue during Q2, driven by surging enterprise demand for generative AI API integrations.
marketLayer.inference: Monetization of enterprise AI services in China is accelerating, helping offset soft consumer e-commerce growth and supporting a valuation re-rating for top-tier HK internet stocks.
marketLayer.keyUncertainty: High capital expenditure on advanced AI infrastructure may compress short-term margins if enterprise API pricing competition intensifies.

marketLayer.title: US Semiconductor & Hyperscaler Capex Momentum
marketLayer.fact: Leading US cloud service providers reaffirmed increased capital expenditure commitments for multi-year AI server deployments, boosting major US chipmaker and equipment manufacturer shares.
marketLayer.inference: Upstream semiconductor design and capital equipment vendors maintain strong order visibility, decoupling their growth trajectories from broader consumer electronics demand softness.
marketLayer.keyUncertainty: Potential tightening of export control regulations and capacity constraints in advanced CoWoS packaging technology.

marketLayer.title: HKEX Innovative Biotech (18A) Out-Licensing Deals
marketLayer.fact: Three HK-listed 18A biotech companies announced cross-border out-licensing transactions totaling over $1.8 billion in upfront and milestone payments with top global pharmaceutical majors.
marketLayer.inference: Global validation of domestic oncology and autoimmune pipelines provides substantial non-dilutive capital, improving balance sheet resilience for commercial-stage HK biotechs.
marketLayer.keyUncertainty: Regulatory approval delays in target overseas jurisdictions and clinical trial execution risks.

marketLayer.title: US Macro Inflation Data & Fed Monetary Expectations
marketLayer.fact: US core inflation metrics printed in line with consensus expectations at 2.6% YoY, reinforcing market expectations for a Federal Reserve rate easing cycle later in the quarter.
marketLayer.inference: Lower Treasury yields ease global liquidity pressure, creating a favorable macro backdrop for growth equities in both US tech and HK-listed risk assets.
marketLayer.keyUncertainty: Labor market resilience or unexpected energy price spikes potentially slowing the Fed's pace of rate cuts.
